config.name: LANTERN-7 Rig Terminal
config.author: EthanDunning
config.comment: LANTERN-7: an original sci-fi horror scenario and a showcase of the file-system screen. A deep-ice drilling rig went silent 19 days ago; the players' crew is the first to dock. Log in as MAINT / 7731; the supervisor's password (HALE / MIRA) is a puzzle hidden across the helpdesk ticket and Hale's crew file, and unlocks the RESTRICTED and RIG CONTROL folders. Shows: classic boot + login screens with onDone auto-advance, two file-system screens ("type": "filesystem") with different folders per account, data tables whose rows open files in place, an image with a blend mode + background, toggles that open dialogs, a diagnostic prompt, a crew-log prompt whose entries are saved (shipLogEntries), and a LOG OUT button (array target). File-system basics: the screen's links are the left-hand folders; each folder's target screen lists its files (its links) top-right, or is a single file if it has no links; the selected file's content shows in the body. Inside a file system, a plain (string) link opens its target in the body: a listed file gets selected, any other classic screen opens in place (the crew files here are opened from table rows). Array-form targets are buttons that navigate away.

content.text: FIELD NOTE: the maintenance login is MAINT / 7731. The supervisor's
password is hidden somewhere in the files.

content: Credentials not recognized. Attempt logged against this terminal.
Yes, I hear it too. Everybody hears it. It started when the bit broke
through at 4,112 m and it hasn't stopped since.
It is **not** the pumps. I shut every pump on the rig down for twenty
minutes last night and it carried on. Same pitch. Same rhythm.
Sato says it's coming *up the shaft*. I told him that's impossible.
There's nothing down there but water and dark.
Ear protectors are in the locker by the Drill Bay airlock. Wear them.

content.text: Do not go down to the shaft collar alone.

content: Effective immediately Deck 3 is off the rota.
Dr. Vasquez-Ren has sealed Med Bay from the inside and asked that
nobody open it until she says so. She sounded calm. Respect it.
Sato's body is in cold storage. I've asked Liaison Brandt to request
an evacuation. I'll let you know the moment I hear back.

> It's in everyone who handled the core. It's in me.
